title_sq: Tek Univers City, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!

title_en: At Univers City, 2+1+2 Apartment for sale, with regular layout!!!
description_en: At Univers City, 2+1+2 Apartment for sale, with regular layout!!! The property is located on the 3rd floor and has a gross area of ​​104.98 m2, of which the net area is 85.97 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The orientation of the property is East. Currently, the construction is in the final stage and is expected to be completed in about 3 months. The area in which the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
